translations.web: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
translations.bsb: He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself; he who rebukes a wicked man taints himself.
translations.kjv: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
translations.asv: He that correcteth a scoffer getteth to himself reviling; And he that reproveth a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
